mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during the inflation spike period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 new jobs per month is associated with stronger consumer confidence and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with PAYEMS spikes (Spearman's rho < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 100) suggests weakening demand or supply constraints, which typically precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 80% of 5-day windows following INDPRO declines show non-negative forward returns (p-value < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) above historical averages indicates resilient consumer and business demand, predicting positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both proxies rising above their 2020-2023 monthly means (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months in a non-recessionary regime, it signals accommodative policy sustaining equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0 for three consecutive months and UNRATE < 4.5
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in all such windows (out of 50 instances).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3% suggests weaker wage pressures, which often coincides with a short-term negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 3.0 in the current month
failure_condition: More than 60% of 5-day windows after UNRATE drops show non-negative returns (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, combined with a sharp drop in GDPC1 (demand), predict negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < previous month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >70% of such regimes (robustness check across 2005-2024).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% during a non-inflationary regime is expected to tighten financial conditions, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative in all such windows (empirical coverage >95%).
